name: social-links-fieldset
title: Social links fieldset
description: Profile links with each network's address pre-filled: paste a full URL and it is cut down to the handle, then checked.
docs: Pass networks (id, label, prefix, pattern, message) and value (or defaultValue) with onValueChange: the value is { website, [networkId]: handle }. Each network is an input group with its prefix in a cell of its own, so people type only the handle. A pasted link to that network is cut down to the handle on the spot, a leading @ is stripped, and a pattern check on blur says what is wrong in the network's message. The website takes anything that parses as an http or https address and adds https:// when it is missing. Only what passed leaves the fieldset: onValueChange, and the hidden input each field sends under its name, hold a handle that matches its pattern, a website that is an http or https address, or an empty string, never the text that failed, so a value is safe to use as a link. The text stays in the field until it is fixed, with the message beside it. What you pass as value or defaultValue is shown as given, not checked. The browser can be bypassed: cleanSocialLinks(networks, input), toHandle, checkHandle and toWebsite are exported from social-links-fieldset/links, a module without "use client", so a server can run the same check on what was posted. Optional rows say "Optional". A pattern can be a RegExp or its source as a string; from a Server Component pass the string. Networks are named in text, never with logos. errors adds your own messages. Nothing is sent anywhere.
